provenance: Rerun from pure trees. Baseline: master 12ae9276, the base of this PR after merging master. Final: this branch with the follow-up test changes (neighbour controls, canonical accepts, sharper overlapping classifier, deterministic shrinking). Neither tree contains the Z3 pilot (#400) tests. Supersedes campaigns_2026-11-07.json, whose baseline and final runs came from a tree that also compiled the #400 tests.

controlled_shrink.note: Test-local wrong operation (Difference checked as Union). Shrinking is deterministic for a given failing seed (ExactBooleanPropertyTests.Shrink; candidate seeds derived from the failing seed only), so these minimized seeds and shrink counts are the same in every run. Before the fix the harness shrank with CsCheck Sample(seed, iter), whose iterations after the first draw from PCG.ThreadPCG (seeded per process, shared per thread), and seed and shrink count changed from run to run.

timing_note: Single bounded runs; durations are observations, not a performance claim.
